ps.basis: Pocket holes in bottoms, tops, stretchers, nailers and fixed shelves: 2 per joint end, plus one for every 7″ of joint

psf.basis: Drawer box fronts and backs into the sides: 2 per end, more on tall drawers

brad.basis: Backs nailed every 4″ around the edge

join.basis: 4 between each pair of neighboring boxes, 6 per filler cleat and placed panel, 4 per upper gable

front.basis: 4 per drawer front, 2 per false front, driven from inside the drawer box

glue.basis: About one 16 oz bottle per 6 cabinets

2x4.basis: Front and back rails plus cross pieces every 16″ under 3 runs of cabinets, plus 10%

conscr.basis: 4 per platform cross piece, plus some to fasten each run down

wall.basis: 2 through each rear nailer into the studs, 2 per wall panel

shim.basis: One bundle per 6 cabinets for leveling the platform and uppers

finish.basis: 305 sq ft of 3/4″ maple, both faces, 3 coats at about 450 sq ft a gallon. Set the price to 0 if your plywood is prefinished.
